pattern: lo = max(lo, a); clean(end+1) = a; nOptFail = 0; %#ok<AGROW>   a clean box raises the lower end
rationale: CSR bisection direction wrong: a box searched clean lowers the upper end of the bracket instead of raising the lower end, so alpha* collapses below the true value (R4-1).

The equal-percentage reference shape is built from the judged sigmas instead of 10 % for every parameter, so it re-imports the judged ratios it is meant to remove (R4-1(b)). Target tUqR4bF16/nonLatticeEqualShape added by agent uq4 (2026-10-14): tUqR4F16/endToEndCsr now runs its longitudinal group on the R4b lattice, so it no longer reaches this (non-lattice) line; the new test runs the non-lattice path with Cm_de (sigma 0.05, so m = sigma differs from 10 %).

pattern: Lc = opts.LipschitzFactor * maxS;           % the Lipschitz estimate: safety factor x measured slopes
rationale: The Lipschitz safety factor 2 is dropped: the grid certificate uses the bare measured secant slopes, which underestimate the true slope between grid points (R4-3).

pattern: u = reflectInto(u, lo, hi, w, rs);
rationale: Differential evolution ignores the bounds: mutated trial vectors outside the box are evaluated, i.e. the global stage samples parameters outside the uncertainty box (R4-4).
The elevator increment of Cm_de is computed against the actual elevator instead of el = 0, so cmt0 = cmt, the increment is zero and Cm_basic scales the whole table (R4-5).
The verdict ignores the CSR counterexample: a confirmed CPV inside the judged box (alpha*(judged) < 1) no longer makes the group NOT_ROBUST, so only a low Clopper-Pearson bound can (R4-2).

The CSR accepts a failing point beyond the cap as its upper bound and then searches boxes beyond AlphaMax (the defect the reduced smoke run of run_f16_uq exposed: equal-shape searches at alpha 8.37 > 3) (R4-1).
